ops.details: Create the destination subpackage if it does not exist.
Move the helper implementation to the helper subpackage to group implementation utilities separately from the main functional interfaces.
Move the runnable implementation/adapter that depends on the helper alongside it to keep related implementation details together.

After moving the whole cluster to the destination package, update only the minimum required visibility in moved classes and related remaining classes so the project can compile. Do not change behavior. Do not move additional classes.
